name: Matter
why_listed: Readers who save articles, newsletters and podcast episodes to listen to with TTS and highlight hands-free, then sync highlights to a notes app, would pick Matter instead of Spoken Margins.

platforms.value: iOS, iPadOS, web, macOS (iPad app on Apple silicon), visionOS
platforms.detail: iPhone and iPad apps, a web app, browser extensions, and the iPad app runs on Apple silicon Macs and Vision Pro. No Android app found.

sources.title: Matter
sources.quote: Matter is the modern read-later app for iPhone, iPad, and web.

sources.title: Matter: Reading App App - App Store
sources.quote: Mac Requires macOS 14.0 or later and a Mac with Apple M1 chip or later.

platforms.note: The App Store marks the Mac version 'Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS.' iOS/iPadOS 26.0 or later required.

price_free_tier.value: Free: unlimited read-later library, save extensions, parsing/readability, unlimited tags, full-text search, themes
price_free_tier.detail: HD text-to-speech, highlighting/notes beyond the free allowance, integrations, AI Co-Reader, RSS/newsletter sync and Send to Kindle are Premium.

sources.title: Matter: Reading App App - App Store
sources.quote: The free version of Matter includes: - Uncapped read-later library - Mobile & web extensions to save all types of content

price_free_tier.note: Premium adds 'Unlimited highlighting, note-taking, and integrations', which implies the free tier has limited highlighting; the limit is not stated.

price_paid.value: App Store (US): Matter Premium USD 7.99/month or USD 79.99/year; Matter Pro Weekly USD 2.99 and Matter Pro (Annual) USD 59.99 also listed. Vendor announcement: USD 8/month or USD 60/year on the web
price_paid.detail: Several in-app plans are listed (Premium, Pro, Patron) without descriptions. The vendor's business-model page gives the web price.

sources.title: Matter: Reading App App - App Store
sources.quote: Matter Premium (Annual) $79.99 Matter Premium (Monthly) $7.99 Matter Pro (Annual) $59.99

sources.title: Matter | Announcing our business model
sources.quote: Matter Premium will cost $8/month or $60/year

price_paid.note: US pages, USD. The business-model page is undated and may be old; getmatter.com/pricing returned 404, so no current web pricing page was found. Which in-app plan a new user is offered is unclear.

plays_podcasts.detail: You share individual episodes from another podcast app (Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Overcast, Castro, Pocket Casts) into Matter, which transcribes them with synced playback. At launch you did not subscribe to podcasts in Matter itself.

sources.title: Matter: Reading App App - App Store
sources.quote: Podcast transcriptions & synced playback

sources.title: Read-it-later app Matter can now transcribe your favorite podcasts | TechCrunch
sources.quote: instead of subscribing to a podcast in Matter itself, you’ll instead share the podcast you want to transcribe from your existing podcast app

plays_podcasts.note: The App Store says Premium can 'add RSS feeds'; whether podcast RSS feeds are supported is not stated. TechCrunch (2023) is press, used because no vendor help page was found.

reads_web_articles_aloud.detail: Turns saved articles and newsletters into a TTS playlist; HD voices are Premium.

sources.title: Matter
sources.quote: Turn your newsletters, blogs, and articles into a playlist with a voice so human it’s hard to distinguish from, well, a human.

reads_pdfs_aloud.detail: Matter saves PDFs and has TTS, but no page read says TTS works on PDFs.

sources.title: Matter: Reading App App - App Store
sources.quote: Save PDFs and YouTube

sources.title: Matter
sources.quote: Save articles, threads, and PDFs.

reads_pdfs_aloud.note: Checked the App Store listing and homepage; no help center found. PDF saving is confirmed, PDF read-aloud is not.

voice_notes_anchored.detail: Notes are attached to highlights; no recorded or dictated voice-note feature found.

sources.title: Matter: Reading App App - App Store
Matter

voice_notes_anchored.note: Checked App Store description and release notes, homepage and privacy policy; no mention of audio or voice notes.

text_notes_anchored.detail: Highlight text (including podcast transcripts) and add notes; unlimited highlighting and notes are Premium.

sources.title: Matter: Reading App App - App Store
sources.quote: Fluid highlighting and note-taking

sources.title: Read-it-later app Matter can now transcribe your favorite podcasts | TechCrunch
sources.quote: you can use Matter’s other tools to interact with the podcast content as you would a saved article, including by doing things like highlighting, taking notes and sharing quotes.

hands_free_capture.detail: 'Audio Highlights' save a passage while listening without looking at the screen.

sources.title: Matter
sources.quote: Audio Highlights Highlight while you listen without looking at the screen.

hands_free_capture.note: The trigger (headphone gesture, Lock Screen, etc.) is not described on the pages read.

transcripts.detail: Saved podcast episodes and YouTube videos are transcribed to time-synced text.

sources.title: Matter
sources.quote: You can even save YouTubes and podcast episodes and Matter will transcribe them to time-synced text.

transcripts.note: TechCrunch (2023) says AI transcription is a Premium feature and Spotify exclusives can't be transcribed.

ai_summaries.detail: Premium includes an 'AI Co-Reader'; the privacy policy lists 'AI summaries you generate' among stored data.

sources.title: Matter Privacy Policy
sources.quote: Content & usage: articles you save, highlights, notes, tags, reading statistics, folders, AI summaries you generate, and feedback you submit.

sources.title: Matter: Reading App App - App Store
sources.quote: Seamless AI Co-Reader

ai_summaries.note: No vendor page describing the summary feature itself was read; evidence is the privacy policy mention. Chapter generation not found.

export_markdown_pkm.detail: Highlights sync to Notion, Obsidian, Roam, Readwise and others; Matter publishes an official Obsidian plugin.

sources.title: Matter: Reading App App - App Store
sources.quote: Sync your highlights to Notion, Obsidian, Roam, Readwise, and others

share_note_at_moment.detail: Matter can share 'Quoteshots' (images of a quote) and share as PDF, but no page says a shared note or clip opens the source at that point for the recipient.

sources.title: Matter
sources.quote: Quoteshots Share beautiful quoteshotes, optimized for X.

share_note_at_moment.note: Checked homepage and App Store listing. A quoteshot is an image, so it does not by itself open the source at a moment.

group_listening.detail: No group, shared library or shared-annotation feature found.

sources.title: Matter
Matter: Reading App App - App Store

group_listening.note: Checked homepage and App Store listing; neither mentions groups or collaboration.

on_device_privacy.detail: Saved articles, highlights, notes and AI summaries are collected and stored by Matter, mainly in the United States.

sources.title: Matter Privacy Policy
sources.quote: We store data primarily in the United States.

on_device_privacy.note: The app is 'available offline by default' (App Store), but offline caching is not an on-device privacy claim.

account_required.detail: An account is created on first launch (Sign in with Apple, Google or email); the privacy policy describes all data as tied to a Matter account.

sources.title: Matter Is the GOAT of Reader Apps · Fueled
sources.quote: Opening Matter, you need to create an account.

sources.title: Matter Privacy Policy
sources.quote: We use this information solely to create and authenticate your Matter account.

account_required.note: The direct statement is from a 2022 third-party blog (Fueled), not the vendor; the vendor privacy policy supports an account model but doesn't say an account is mandatory.
